entities.summary: The Princes Czartoryski Library – often abbreviated to Czartoryski Library – is a branch of the National Museum in Kraków, located at 17 St Mark Street in Kraków. It is a Polish foundation library established at the initiative of Prince Adam Kazimierz Czartoryski and Izabela Czartoryska nee Fleming in the second half of the 18th century.
